title: Heatstroke
immediate_warning: Cool the person down immediately. Heatstroke can cause death or brain damage within minutes.

description: Heatstroke occurs when the body temperature rises dangerously high (above 40°C). It is a medical emergency common in hot Nigerian weather.

description_translations.en: Heatstroke occurs when the body temperature rises dangerously high (above 40°C). It is a medical emergency common in hot Nigerian weather.

signs: Hot, red, and dry skin (no sweating)

1.en: Hot, red, and dry skin (no sweating)

steps.instruction: Move the person to a cool, shaded area immediately.

instruction_translations.en: Move the person to a cool, shaded area immediately.

steps.instruction: Cool them rapidly: apply cool water to skin, fan vigorously, or use wet towels on neck, armpits, and groin.

do_not: Do not give medication for fever in heatstroke.
Do not leave the person alone.
Do not use ice-cold water — it can cause shock.
